history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration closely follow up on the process of the roll-out of the new Umoja danger pay solution in 2021 to avoid future undue payments to staff.
history.administration_response: The new Umoja danger pay solution was deployed in August 2021. Under the new solution, danger pay is paid to eligible staff members based on online self-certification of the days physically present at the danger pay location, ensuring that danger pay is only paid to staff who self-certify their presence in a danger pay location. Online manuals have been created for staff, human resources partners and human resources administrators. A business intelligence data model has been developed and reports are available for entities to monitor the danger pay submissions of their staff. A related guidance note has been distributed on the use of these reports. The Administration considers this item fully implemented.
history.board_assessment: Given that the new Umoja danger pay solution was deployed in August 2021, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
